== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a Facebook photograph posted 3 October 2017. The Facebook photo viewer names Jean-Luc Simard. Identification: exact name plus Gold 27 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Sherbrooke, QC). Francis K. Lalumière commented on the photograph. Bill found this Facebook profile after a Jean-Luc Simard liked a photograph on Francis Lalumiere's Facebook page.

A second photograph, posted 16 July 2026, is in Photographs. Francis K. Lalumière also commented on that post.

The preserved copies are screenshots of those Facebook photo viewers (name and date as they appeared). Identification stays on this Talk page. See [[:File:Jean-Luc Simard Facebook portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Jean-Luc Simard 2026.jpg]].
